body:
External audit root: `/tmp/osf_5qxkh`. The two inputs for the 136-vs-122 check are:

- `/tmp/osf_5qxkh/prose_data/details.csv` — OSF GUID d238q, SHA-256 `3ff15dcc66515d5f20b20072505fa4068e3cc129edd71ebb5dd6338a9c91d012`
- `/tmp/osf_5qxkh/story_recall_full_scored.csv` — OSF GUID ptg3b, SHA-256 `dfe11d5c30183e6760b5e63be1bbf6cd32c4d4db865affce1f81903d4d6f6ece`

Exact aggregate-only reproduction command (prints no participant IDs or prose):

```sh
Rscript -e 'd <- read.csv("/tmp/osf_5qxkh/prose_data/details.csv", check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE); d <- subset(d, redundant == ""); s <- read.csv("/tmp/osf_5qxkh/story_recall_full_scored.csv", check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE); print(table(d$task)); print(tapply(paste(s$task,s$story,s$detID,sep="\034"), s$task, function(x) length(unique(x)))); print(length(unique(paste(d$task,d$story,d$detail,sep="\034")))); print(length(unique(paste(s$task,s$story,s$detail,sep="\034"))))'
```

Observed output: expected rows by task 46/49/41; retained unique items by task 42/48/32; totals 136 and 122.

The upstream mechanism is visible in `/tmp/osf_5qxkh/01_gather_human_scores.R` (SHA-256 `62cb00eab6c776b1944719aaf58af26feac6d1f74741a2c3e18b618925283c84`): `scores_detailed <- merge(detail,scores_all)` has no `by`, so base R chooses every shared column name, including mutable `detail` strings, as an inner-join key. The downstream fixed denominators are in `/tmp/osf_5qxkh/04_gather_all_data.R` (SHA-256 `8f3d50de8b5eb669978d0d5aef9b408617f73927f0b69f8ef6e0e464b6b0ca13`). Please independently confirm or correct the consequence claim; do not inspect or publish participant prose.
